19.08.2025 C528 No.1416 of 2025
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
This Application under Section 528 of 
the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 
2023 has been filed by the applicant against 
the impugned order dated 29.04.2025, 
passed by learned Judicial Magistrate, 
Laksar, District Haridwar, by which the 
learned Magistrate has directed to frame the 
charges under Sections 420, 467, 468 & 
471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860. The 
applicant had filed a criminal revision. The 
said criminal revision has been dismissed. 
2. Heard Mr. Tapan Singh, learned 
counsel for the applicant and Mr. Pradeep 
Lohani, learned Brief Holder for the 
respondent no.1. 
3. Mr. Pradeep Lohani, Brief Holder has 
sought ten days’ time to get instructions on 
the Annexure no.8 and service book of the 
applicant. 
4. Time is granted.
5. List on 29.08.2025.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 
 19.08.2025
JKJ/Pant
